about: Known misses of npm run check (the PM, 2026-10-09). A listed check is still measured and printed, marked KNOWN MISS in report.md; the run fails only on a failure that is not listed here; a listed check that passes is reported as NOW PASSING, and its entry stays until its clearing condition is met. Entries are added or removed only on the PM's or Kian's word. This file decides PASS, so the suite refuses to start while it has uncommitted changes. Fields: id; title; step (the suite step's id); checks (the drill's check ids it covers); target; cause; clears (the condition that removes the entry); listed (when and by whom). Since 2026-10-12 (the PM): every entry records a baseline per listed check, { over: samples over the target, of: samples, worst }, from the run it names; a run in which a listed check measures worse (more over the target, as a rate when the number of samples differs; or a worse worst value beyond the entry's tolerance) fails with KNOWN MISS WORSENED. A baseline is lowered only when a fix improves it.

misses.title: after-tap photos, Senso
misses.target: the first section's photos in view loaded within 2500 ms of the language tap, under Slow 4G as DevTools applies it and CPU 4×, on the worse of two repeats (Senso with its first section as a List and as a Grid)
misses.cause: Senso's photos are linked at full size from the client's own hosts: the first section's 6 photos weigh 237–367 KB each, 1.70 MB in all (Kebab Land's 2 weigh 72–146 KB). Over Slow 4G the 4 in view loaded 4.7–8.3 s after the tap in the five runs of 2026-10-09 (16-28-47Z to 20-55-53Z); the menu itself was visible within 228–260 ms in every one, and Kebab Land's photos within 262–1062 ms.
misses.clears: when resized copies of the photos are served from our own storage (the go-live list; downloading the photos needs the owner's written permission first)

baseline.set: 2026-10-12, the PM: as measured in that run (each check is the worse of 2 repeats over Slow 4G). Tolerance 10 % on the worst value, a decision taken by the build agent for the PM to confirm: the same measurement on unchanged code ranged 7975–8409 ms (List) and 4692–5195 ms (Grid) over the 13 committed runs (2026-10-09 to 2026-10-12), so a strict comparison would fail about half the runs on noise of a few milliseconds

misses.title: Senso LCP with uploaded photos
misses.target: Lighthouse mobile run on /senso, LCP ≤ 2500 ms on each of the three runs (the PM's build decision: Largest Contentful Paint ≤ 2.5 s in a Lighthouse mobile run)
misses.cause: Since 2026-10-12 Kian has put uploaded photos on Senso's items (22 by 04:00, 1254 × 1254 px JPEG, 122–223 KB each; the admin shrinks only above 1400 px or 700 KB; shown at 96 px in a row and 173 px in a grid card). They are served by the same server and load behind the welcome screen; Lighthouse's simulation counts them on the way to the LCP element, which is still the welcome logo (loaded in about 1.2 s), adding a render delay of about 6 s. Not the code: feeb1cc gives the same on the same data (7208 / 4730 / 7210 ms, by hand), and run 2026-10-12T03-57-29Z, before the uploads, measured 1503 ms. Kian: no change to photo quality for now.
misses.clears: when resized photos are served (not scheduled)

baseline.set: 2026-10-12, the PM: run 2026-10-12T07-54-45Z (the full suite on 1d77893), LCP 4805 / 7213 / 7212 ms, worst 7213 ms, tolerance 10 %
